name: Descript
description: Descript is an AI-powered text-based audio and video editor that automatically transcribes recordings, removes filler words, and clones voices with Overdub.
best_for: Podcasters, video creators, marketing teams, and educators who want fast text-based video and audio editing.
features: Text-based video and audio editing: edit transcripts to cut and rearrange media instantly
Studio Sound: AI audio cleanup removing background noise and room echo in one click
One-click filler word removal (eradicates ums, uhs, you knows, and repeated words)
Overdub AI voice cloning: type text to correct audio errors in your own voice
AI eye contact correction, green screen background removal, and automatic caption generator

tiers.name: Creator
tiers.notes: 30 hrs transcription/month, 4K exports, and AI voice cloning.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: 40 hrs transcription/month, full AI Suite, priority support.

pros: Text-based editing workflow streamlines podcast and video editing by editing spoken words directly in the transcript
Studio Sound AI audio processing makes smartphone mics sound like professional studio microphones
Comprehensive AI suite (filler word removal, eye contact correction, Overdub) built into one tool
cons: Desktop application can be resource-intensive during heavy multi-track 4K video rendering
Overdub voice synthesis is specialized for quick audio correction rather than generating entire audiobooks from scratch
Monthly transcription hours are capped by plan tier, requiring add-on purchases for heavy volume
